scenes.headline: How a model trains on questions it wrote itself
scenes.sub: On-policy self-training, one loop at a time.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Bootstrap! A model can improve on questions and answers it wrote itself. Here is the loop, and why the answer goes in the teacher's context.

scenes.text: Give the model only topic names. It writes questions and answers, filters them, and a teacher that reads the answer as context trains the student.
scenes.say: The idea: give the model only topic names. It writes its own questions and answers, filters them, and a teacher that reads the answer as context trains the student.

steps.say: Topic names go to the generator, which writes a question, a rationale and a candidate answer.
Verification asks it to solve the question again, and a paraphrase. The gate drops questions the student already solves every time.
The student sees only the question. The teacher sees the answer too.
At every token of the student's own rollout, the student is pulled toward the teacher.
Then the teacher moves a little toward the student, and the loop repeats.

left.title: As the target
items: Copy the answer token by token
A wrong answer is learned as truth
left.say: Train on the answer, and a wrong answer is learned as truth.

right.title: As teacher context
items: The teacher weighs it against its own belief
A wrong answer bends the target
right.say: Give it to the teacher as context, and the teacher weighs it against its own belief. A wrong answer only bends the target.

scenes.title: The teacher is a slow average

parts.note: keep most of the old teacher
parts.say: Keep most of the old teacher.

parts.note: blend in a little student, 0.05 works best
parts.say: Blend in a little of the student. The paper's best rate is zero point zero five.

scenes.title: Toy test: 75% wrong answers
scenes.say: In my small toy, with three in four answers wrong, plain fine-tuning falls to forty-two percent. The teacher-context loop holds at seventy-eight.

scenes.title: Paper: MMLU with 75% wrong answers
scenes.say: The paper reports the same shape on a real model. SFT ends below the base. The new loop stays above it.

scenes.text: Put the generated answer in the teacher's context, not the loss, and a wrong answer bends the target instead of setting it.
scenes.say: Put the generated answer in the teacher's context, not in the loss.

recap: Models can write their own problems
The answer is context, not target
An EMA teacher keeps it stable
scenes.say: A model writes its own problems, the answer is context rather than target, and a slow teacher keeps it stable.
